gaps.title: Complete product and internal API operation contracts
gaps.already_defined: Role-aware API behavior, selected submission statuses and private media are required; domain schemas are supplied.
gaps.missing_definition: No complete method/path/operation inventory or transport contract defines request bodies, response bodies, headers, authentication, revision preconditions, pagination, idempotency scope, or errors for author/review/publication/disputes/import/admin/speech operations.
gaps.answer_needed: Specify the operation contracts for every row of api-obligations.md, including required/nullable fields, defaults, ranges, success/error status and atomic effects. Engineering can draft these; identify any required route conventions.
gaps.closure_positive: Every in-scope operation has one versioned request/response/security/error contract and links to its flow and owner.
gaps.closure_negative: An omitted operation, undefined payload/status or unbound route prevents an API-complete claim.

gaps.title: Public and private transport projections

gaps.answer_needed: Define each view field-by-field, its audience/state, and when transcripts/keys/evidence become visible. Decide whether a teacher receives the complete key after submission or only result-linked excerpts.
gaps.closure_positive: Every state/role projection emits only its explicitly allowed fields, including errors, caches and metadata.
gaps.closure_negative: A hidden field in any pre-submit or blind-review projection is rejected.

gaps.answer_needed: Provide a domain entity dictionary covering all schemas plus users/roles, qualifications, reviews, permissions, releases/manifests, transformations, stages, audit, disclosures, disputes and result revisions; define each relation and uniqueness scope.
gaps.closure_positive: Every field and reference maps to a declared durable entity/constraint and one immutable version identity.
gaps.closure_negative: Dangling, cross-tenant, duplicate or mutable historical references fail the declared constraints.

gaps.title: Database and object-store commit protocol

locations.anchor: Keep provider responses and evidence in private storage
Hashes identify stored immutable byte payloads

gaps.already_defined: Domain/audit changes commit together; asset bytes are private and immutable.
gaps.missing_definition: PostgreSQL and MinIO have no joint transaction specification. Pending uploads, hash verification, object promotion, orphan handling, overwrite/race behavior and crash recovery are unspecified.
gaps.answer_needed: Define the durable asset states and ordered upload/hash/DB-link operations, visibility guards, cleanup permission and recovery for every crash boundary without a background queue.
gaps.closure_positive: Only a durable hash-verified immutable object can become visible through a committed authorized record.
gaps.closure_negative: A partial upload, DB rollback, competing overwrite or crash cannot publish a missing or changed object.

gaps.missing_definition: Publisher/adjudicator are workflow labels with no mapping to the four roles. Read/write/publish/quarantine/adjudicate/import/configure rights, same-person restrictions and admin scope are not a complete matrix.

gaps.closure_positive: Every operation has a deny-by-default role/resource/state rule and immutable actor evidence.
gaps.closure_negative: Unauthorized, other-tenant, self-conflicting or model-origin actions are denied.
